description: This file declares functions, macros, and external references related to the Realtek RTL8367C switch's Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) features. It contains function prototypes for enabling and retrieving EEE settings on specific ports, and defines hardware address constants.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicEee100M
methods.description: Sets the Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) mode for 100M ports.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicEee100M
methods.description: Retrieves the EEE enabled status for 100M ports.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicEeeGiga
methods.description: Sets the EEE mode for Gigabit ports.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicEeeGiga
methods.description: Retrieves the EEE enabled status for Gigabit ports.
